chunks: They will say: 'All praise be to God who has removed care from us. Indeed our Lord is forgiving and rewarding.'
ai.seo_question: What do the people of Paradise say when they enter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (41:34) is often linked to the concept of *Tawassul* and the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt, as the 'people of Paradise' are seen as those who attained closeness to God through the Prophet and his progeny. The attributes Al-Ghafur and Ash-Shakur are interpreted not just as general mercy, but as specific divine responses to the enduring patience and gratitude of the faithful during their earthly trials. This declaration marks the culmination of the spiritual journey, where sorrow is permanently replaced by the joy of divine proximity.
